title: Fix image loading failure in shop interface

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the image loading mechanism in CosmeticItem component to ensure all product images load correctly from /assets/generated directory
acceptanceCriteria: All 50 cosmetic item images display correctly in the shop grid
No 'Failed to load' errors appear on any cosmetic items
Fallback sparkles icon only appears if image genuinely does not exist
Image paths correctly resolve to /assets/generated with proper filename mapping

file_operations.description: Fix the image path generation logic to correctly map cosmetic item names to their corresponding filenames in frontend/public/assets/generated. Update the slug mapping function to handle special characters, spaces, capitalization, and ensure the path format matches the actual generated image filenames (e.g., frontend/public/assets/generated/golden-banana.dim_400x400.png). Add proper error handling and logging to diagnose any remaining image loading issues.

requirements.summary: Verify that all 50 generated cosmetic item images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated directory with correct filenames
acceptanceCriteria: All expected image files are present in the correct directory
Filenames follow the slug pattern derived from item names
Image dimensions match the expected format (e.g., dim_400x400)
No broken image references in the component code

file_operations.description: Add a comprehensive mapping table or reference list that documents all 50 cosmetic item names and their corresponding image filenames in frontend/public/assets/generated. This ensures the component can correctly resolve each item to its image file. Include inline comments listing the expected items and their slug mappings for maintainability.

requirements.summary: Ensure the image slug mapping function correctly converts all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic item names to their corresponding image filenames in both CosmeticItem and OwnedItemsView components
acceptanceCriteria: Slug generation handles special characters, spaces, and capitalization correctly
All item names map to valid image filenames
The mapping is consistent across both Shop and Owned Items views
Edge cases like items with apostrophes or special symbols are handled properly

file_operations.description: Refactor the slug mapping function to consistently convert item names to lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens, remove or replace special characters (apostrophes, symbols), and append the correct dimension suffix (.dim_400x400.png). Ensure the function produces filenames that exactly match those in frontend/public/assets/generated (e.g., 'Golden Banana' → 'golden-banana.dim_400x400.png').

Update the slug mapping function in OwnedItemsView to use the same logic as CosmeticItem, ensuring consistency across both views. Extract the slug generation into a shared utility function if possible, or duplicate the exact same transformation logic to guarantee identical behavior when displaying owned items.
